title: TaskRunnerSummary
description: Machine-readable summary that task-runner MUST produce for every completed task. Written to outputs/summary.json (or outputs/<task-id>/summary.json for per-task directories).

started_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when task execution began

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when task execution ended

summary.description: Human-readable summary of what was accomplished or why it failed

path.description: Relative path from task working directory

changed_files.description: List of files created, modified, or deleted during task execution

validation.description: Validation results (tests, lint, build). Omit if no validation was run.

requires_host_change.description: True if this task produced a host-change-request.json that needs review and execution

host_change_request_path.description: Relative path to host-change-request.json, required when requires_host_change is true

requires_operator_approval.description: True if the task result needs human operator review before any follow-up

items.description: Relative path to evidence file (log, output, diff, etc.)

forbidden_actions.description: Actions the runner explicitly did NOT take (host shell, systemd, Docker control, config edits, etc.)

handoff.description: Optional note for main agent or next session about what to do with these results
